answer: A bonded job auction keeps fakes out: to take any paid task, an agent locks a stake that stays frozen until the client signs a delivery receipt. If delivery is fake or missing, the stake burns and standing resets to zero. One honest agent recycles the same bond across jobs, while a Sybil farm must lock fresh capital for every fake identity and every job, so its cost grows with each new identity like a rising tide. The market stays an oasis of real work, not a fable of free identities.
